Keep snapshots only its object. Parent changes have independent records; CopyFrom no longer transfers Parent. Proven mutation paths record pre-edit object data and hierarchy changes.

Copied trees remain detached, so Copy no longer removes an unlinked copy through the live world lifecycle. The previous targetname buffer is initialized before unnamed-to-named redo dependency relinking.

Exactly 13 native accepted types; integer angle storage. Source readonly, extended description and omitted-default syntax removed. Existing defaults, choices, flags, reportable-copy behavior and installed SDK FGD remain passing.

source_adapters: Nonserialized generated helpers are omitted from pointer-based source history; native field behavior differs. IsTemporary remains unchanged because source visibility traversal requires visible helpers to be nontemporary.
Entity Undo notifications regenerate helper state and then update live dependencies; helper objects themselves are not independent persistent map objects.
Automatic mutation snapshots and parent records are scoped to the active map. Detached clipboard/prefab construction does not enter that map history.
Existing recursive KeepNew callers are retained as a source frontend compatibility path; native public KeepNew records one object.
Deleted-object cleanup on source history shutdown/disable differs from native cleanup mode 2 because this source history owns those detached objects.
World membership transitions use source document lifecycle APIs to preserve entity caches, culling, visibility and preload.
